modal.title: Best Delegate ×2 — Masters' Summit MUN
modal.desc: Back-to-back Best Delegate at Masters' Summit MUN in 2024 and 2025 — the circuit's proof of consistency. Two different agendas, the same method: deep committee research, evidence-first argumentation and coalition-building that holds up over long sessions. Came with a ₹15,000 cash prize.

modal.title: 3rd — MU20 Opportunity Summit
modal.desc: Placed 3rd in the AIPPM committee at the MU20 Opportunity Summit 2024 — an international summit. Contemporary Indian policy and economics, high-pressure committee dynamics, and arguments that had to survive scrutiny from a national field. Also took 2nd at Sahodaya MUN (ECOSOC).

modal.title: Rapid Chess — Strategy Under the Clock
modal.desc: 2nd place at the U-19 State Level Rapid Chess championship (2025) and 10th in Under-18 Boys at the UICC Trophy (2024). Chess is where the analytical habit was built — probabilistic thinking, pattern recognition and calm decisions under time pressure.

modal.title: Transportation Research Project
modal.desc: Conducted an independent research project on Transportation for the Balvigyan Inter-School Commerce competition — primary and secondary data collection, identifying patterns in transportation economics and urban mobility, structuring findings into a coherent analytical narrative, and presenting conclusions to a judging panel. Won Best Research & Project across competing schools.
